projects.name: Storefront API
projects.description: End-to-end cloud & on-premises application with 8-stage pipeline, WhatsApp API, and MongoDB.

pipelineStages.name: 1. Architecture & Scaffolding
pipelineStages.description: Stack selection, clean monorepo architecture, dependency resolution, and multi-stage production Docker containerization.
logs: [BUILD] Initializing workspace scaffolding engine...
[BUILD] Detected runtime: Node.js v24.15 / Express REST API
[BUILD] Resolving dependencies from npm registry with clean lockfile.
[BUILD] Compiling 184 client & server modules (0.64s).

pipelineStages.name: 2. Third-Party APIs Integration
pipelineStages.description: Pre-wire third-party developer APIs including WhatsApp Cloud API, Stripe checkout, OpenAI LLMs, Twilio SMS, and transactional webhooks.
logs: [API] Configuring third-party API communication layer...
[API] WhatsApp Cloud API webhook listener registered at /api/webhook/whatsapp.
[API] Verifying WhatsApp Meta Graph API access token handshake... 200 OK.
[API] Pre-wired Stripe checkout sessions & customer webhooks.
[API] Loaded AI agent endpoints for real-time prompt generation.
[SUCCESS] Stage 2 [Third-Party APIs Integration]: Verified! Status: GREEN ✓

pipelineStages.name: 3. Automated Test Matrix
pipelineStages.description: Execute automated unit test suites, integration mock servers, and Playwright / Supertest API assertion contracts.
logs: [TEST] Launching Vitest in-process test runner...
[TEST] ✓ Auth Module Suite: 16 passed
[TEST] ✓ Database CRUD & Migration Suite: 18 passed
[TEST] ✓ WhatsApp Cloud API & Webhook Suite: 14 passed
[TEST] ✓ End-to-End Pipeline Controller: 16 passed
[TEST] 64/64 test suites completed with 0 failures.
[SUCCESS] Stage 3 [Automated Test Matrix]: Passed! Status: GREEN ✓

pipelineStages.name: 4. Static Code Quality & Sonar Gate
pipelineStages.description: SonarQube static code analysis, ESLint standards, cyclomatic complexity auditing, and zero technical debt enforcement.
logs: [QUALITY] Running SonarQube Scanner v10.4...
[QUALITY] Audited 8,420 lines of code across 32 source files.
[QUALITY] Maintainability Rating: A | Reliability: A | Security: A.
[QUALITY] Code coverage measured at 96.2% across critical paths.
[QUALITY] Zero code smells or architectural debt detected.
[SUCCESS] Stage 4 [Static Code Quality & Sonar Gate]: Passed! Status: GREEN ✓

pipelineStages.name: 5. OWASP & Container Security Audit
pipelineStages.description: OWASP Top 10 vulnerability inspection, automated secret scanning, and container CVE vulnerability audits via Trivy.
logs: [SECURITY] Initiating OWASP Top 10 automated security audit...
[SECURITY] Scanning git commit tree for leaked secrets or private keys: Clean.
[SECURITY] Running Trivy vulnerability scan against Docker image layers: 0 CVEs.
[SECURITY] Audited dependency tree for cross-site scripting (XSS) & injection: Clean.
[SUCCESS] Stage 5 [OWASP & Container Security Audit]: Passed! Status: GREEN ✓

pipelineStages.name: 6. Database Provisioning & Migration
pipelineStages.description: Provision localhost MongoDB database (localhost:27017) or Atlas replica set, apply collection indexes, and auto-seed initial data.

config.indexes: Unique index on { username, email, mobile }

logs: [DATABASE] Connecting to MongoDB instance at mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017...

[DATABASE] Ensuring collections: users, projects, contacts, logs.
[DATABASE] Applied unique index on username, email, and mobile fields.
[DATABASE] Storage engine verified: WiredTiger high-throughput engine.
[SUCCESS] Stage 6 [Database Provisioning & Migration]: Active! Status: GREEN ✓

pipelineStages.name: 7. Cloud / On-Prem Deployment
pipelineStages.description: Rollout containerized application to Cloud Provider (AWS ECS / GCP Cloud Run) or On-Premises Docker Swarm / Kubernetes.
logs: [DEPLOY] Verifying target cluster infrastructure...
[DEPLOY] Target: Cloud Provider (AWS ECS Fargate) / On-Premises.
[DEPLOY] Pushing release container to container registry...
[DEPLOY] Initiating zero-downtime rolling deployment...
[DEPLOY] 2/2 healthy container replicas serving traffic behind ALB.
[SUCCESS] Stage 7 [Cloud / On-Prem Deployment]: Live! Status: GREEN ✓

pipelineStages.name: 8. Zero-Trust Network & Live Production
pipelineStages.description: Auto-provision TLS 1.3 certificates, CORS origin protection, Cloudflare WAF, and 24/7 synthetic health monitoring.

config.waf: Cloudflare Edge Shield & Rate Limiting (100 req/min)

logs: [VERIFY] Generating Let's Encrypt TLS 1.3 encryption certificates...
[VERIFY] Hardening response headers with Helmet (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)...
[VERIFY] Synthetic ping test to /api/health: 200 OK (Latency: 14ms).
[VERIFY] All 8 Pipeline stages verified with GREEN marks!
[SUCCESS] Stage 8 [Zero-Trust Network & Live Production]: Application is fully online!
